config_dir.description: The directory where luakit looks for user configuration files.

process_limit.description: Set the number of web processes to use. A value of 0 means 'no limit'. This has no effect since WebKit 2.26.

data_dir.description: The data directory for luakit, used for storing cookies and other persistent data.

xdg_config_home.description: The XDG_CONFIG_HOME environment variable path, used in comments for documentation.
